name: Sadhu J
tagline: B.E. AIML graduate and Software Engineer at ODEE, building toward agents, systems, and robots

about.headline: Software Engineer at ODEE | AI systems, agents, and robotics
paragraphs: I am a Software Engineer – Full Stack & DevOps and Team Lead at ODEE India Private Limited in Bengaluru. I lead a 5-member engineering team and ship a cross-platform React Native app plus the web platform with Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, and Supabase, including a soft launch past 200 active users. Kotlin and Jetpack Compose were the earlier Android app. The longer path is the system around the model: the agent, the infrastructure, then the hardware.
highlights: Leading a 5-member team on React Native, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, and Supabase. Earlier Android work used Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, with Flutter, Firebase, and Google Play Console.
Comfortable working with TensorFlow, PyTorch, OpenCV and deploying ML-powered features backed by Azure and GCP.
Ships with GitHub Actions, Docker, and DigitalOcean, including a soft launch that reached 200+ active users.
Active computer vision and local-LLM work, with a deliberate path toward agentic systems and physical robots.
about.goal: Build intelligent autonomous systems end to end, from the model and agent through software and infrastructure to physical robots, and work toward the frontier of agentic AI and robotics.
